title: デビュー戦の後に・まずは一歩

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Sakura Chiyono O begins to reflect on what she needs to improve as well as what skills she can utilize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to accomplish her dream of winning the Derby, she decides to run in a G1 race—the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not long after, she tells her friends Yaeno Muteki and Mejiro Ardan about her next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki, eager to see the moment Sakura Chiyono O bares her fangs in a race, says she'll go watch her at the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.
